data.name: Naseefa
data.gender_notes: Naseefa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Naseefa means 'delicate, tender, sweet'. It is a name that evokes images of gentle kindness and wisdom. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess these qualities. The name Naseefa carries the meaning “Delicate, tender, sweet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naseefa usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender, sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naseefa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
